title: द्वाविंशतितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 22 · Shakuni's army and the Pandava chiefs

summary.en: The Kaurava army falters, and the elephants and horses turn in flight, while Shakuni turns back to the fight. The Pandavas grow weary, and Sanjaya describes the dreadful cries of the battle at sundown.
summary.kn: ಕೌರವ ಸೈನ್ಯ ತಡವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಆನೆ, ಕುದುರೆಗಳು ಓಡುತ್ತವೆ, ಶಕುನಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ಹೋರಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ತಿರುಗುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಪಾಂಡವರು ದಣಿಯುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಸಂಜೆಯ ಯುದ್ಧದ ಭಯಂಕರ ಕೂಗನ್ನು ಸಂಜಯ ವರ್ಣಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: कौरव सेना डगमगाती है, हाथी-घोड़े भागते हैं और शकुनि फिर युद्ध की ओर मुड़ता है। पाण्डव थक जाते हैं, और संजय सायंकालीन युद्ध की भयंकर चीखों का वर्णन करते हैं।
summary.te: కౌరవసేన తడబడుతుంది; ఏనుగులు గుర్రాలు పారిపోతాయి, శకుని మళ్లీ పోరుకు తిరుగుతాడు. పాండవులు అలసిపోతారు; సాయంకాల యుద్ధం భయంకర కేకలను సంజయుడు వర్ణిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: கௌரவப் படை தளர, யானை குதிரைகள் ஓட, சகுனி மீண்டும் போருக்குத் திரும்புகிறான். பாண்டவர் களைக்க, மாலைப் போரின் கொடிய கூச்சல்களைச் சஞ்சயன் விவரிக்கிறான்.
summary.ml: കൗരവസേന പതറുന്നു; ആനകളും കുതിരകളും തിരിഞ്ഞോടുന്നു, എന്നാൽ ശകുനി യുദ്ധത്തിലേക്ക് തിരിച്ചുവരുന്നു. പാണ്ഡവർ ക്ഷീണിക്കുന്നു; സൂര്യാസ്തമയസമയത്തെ യുദ്ധത്തിന്റെ ഭയങ്കര നിലവിളികൾ സഞ്ജയൻ വിവരിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 9.22; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jun 23 2020

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
वर्तमाने तथा युद्धे घोररूपे भयानके ।
अभज्यत बलं तत्र तव पुत्रस्य पाण्डवैः ॥

meaning.en: While that dreadful, fearsome battle went on, your son's army was broken there by the Pandavas.

verses.text:
तांस्तु यत्नेन महता संनिवार्य महारथान् ।
पुत्रस्ते योधयामास पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: Your son, holding those great chariot-fighters back with great effort, went on fighting the Pandava army.

verses.text:
निवृत्ताः सहसा योधास्तव पुत्रप्रियैषिणः ।
संनिवृत्तेषु तेष्वेवं युद्धमासीत्सुदारुणम् ॥

meaning.en: Your warriors, wishing to please your son, suddenly turned back, and with them rallied the fighting became savage indeed.

verses.text:
तावकानां परेषां च देवासुररणोपमम् ।
परेषां तव सैन्ये च नासीत्कश्चित्पराङ्मुखः ॥

meaning.en: The battle between your men and the enemy was like the war of gods and demons; no one on either side turned his back.

verses.text:
अनुमानेन युध्यन्ते संज्ञाभिश्च परस्परम् ।
तेषां क्षयो महानासीद्युध्यतामितरेतरम् ॥

meaning.en: They fought one another by guess and by signs, and great was the slaughter among them as they fought each other.

verses.text:
ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा क्रोधेन महता युतः ।
जिगीषमाणः संग्रामे धार्तराष्ट्रान्सराजकान् ॥

meaning.en: Then King Yudhishthira, filled with great anger and eager to conquer the Dhartarashtras and their allied kings in the battle,

verses.text:
त्रिभिः शारद्वतं विद्ध्वा रुक्मपुङ्खैः शिलाशितैः ।
चतुर्भिर्निजघानाश्वान्कल्याणान्कृतवर्मणः ॥

meaning.en: pierced Kripa, son of Sharadvat, with three gold-feathered arrows whetted on stone, and with four killed the fine horses of Kritavarman.

verses.text:
अश्वत्थामा तु हार्दिक्यमपोवाह यशस्विनम् ।
अथ शारद्वतोऽष्टाभिः प्रत्यविध्यद्युधिष्ठिरम् ॥

meaning.en: Ashvatthama carried the renowned Kritavarman, the Hridika's son, away, and Kripa then pierced Yudhishthira with eight arrows in return.

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनो राजा रथान्सप्तशतान्रणे ।
प्रेषयद्यत्र राजासौ धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: Then King Duryodhana sent seven hundred chariots in the battle to where the king, Yudhishthira son of Dharma, stood.

verses.text:
ते रथा रथिभिर्युक्ता मनोमारुतरंहसः ।
अभ्यद्रवन्त संग्रामे कौन्तेयस्य रथं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Those chariots, manned by chariot-fighters and swift as mind and wind, charged in the battle at the chariot of Kunti's son.

verses.text:
ते समन्तान्महाराज परिवार्य युधिष्ठिरम् ।
अदृश्यं सायकैश्चक्रुर्मेघा इव दिवाकरम् ॥

meaning.en: O great king, they surrounded Yudhishthira on all sides and hid him with their arrows, as clouds hide the sun.

verses.text:
नामृष्यन्त सुसंरब्धाः शिखण्डिप्रमुखा रथाः ।
रथैरग्र्यजवैर्युक्तैः किङ्किणीजालसंवृतैः ।
आजग्मुरभिरक्षन्तः कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम् ॥

meaning.en: Shikhandi and the other chariot-fighters, greatly enraged, could not bear it; with chariots of the fastest pace, covered in nets of tinkling bells, they came to protect Yudhishthira, son of Kunti.

verses.text:
ततः प्रववृते रौद्रः संग्रामः शोणितोदकः ।
पाण्डवानां कुरूणां च यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनः ॥

meaning.en: Then began a fearsome battle between the Pandavas and the Kurus, flowing with blood, that swelled the kingdom of Yama.

verses.text:
रथान्सप्तशतान्हत्वा कुरूणामाततायिनाम् ।
पाण्डवाः सह पाञ्चालैः पुनरेवाभ्यवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: Having killed seven hundred chariots of the murderous Kurus, the Pandavas with the Panchalas again advanced against them.

verses.text:
तत्र युद्धं महच्चासीत्तव पुत्रस्य पाण्डवैः ।
न च नस्तादृशं दृष्टं नैव चापि परिश्रुतम् ॥

meaning.en: Great was the fight there between your son and the Pandavas; we had never seen or heard of the like.

verses.text:
वर्तमाने तथा युद्धे निर्मर्यादे समन्ततः ।
वध्यमानेषु योधेषु तावकेष्वितरेषु च ॥

meaning.en: While the battle raged on in this way, without limit on every side, and warriors of your side and the other were being killed,

verses.text:
निनदत्सु च योधेषु शङ्खवर्यैश्च पूरितैः ।
उत्कृष्टैः सिंहनादैश्च गर्जितेन च धन्विनाम् ॥

meaning.en: while the warriors roared, the finest conches were blown, lion-shouts went up and archers bellowed,

verses.text:
अतिप्रवृद्धे युद्धे च छिद्यमानेषु मर्मसु ।
धावमानेषु योधेषु जयगृद्धिषु मारिष ॥

meaning.en: while the battle grew exceedingly fierce, vital spots were being cut, and the warriors, greedy for victory, ran about, O revered one,

verses.text:
संहारे सर्वतो जाते पृथिव्यां शोकसंभवे ।
बह्वीनामुत्तमस्त्रीणां सीमन्तोद्धरणे तथा ॥

meaning.en: when destruction was happening everywhere, grief was arising on earth and the partings of many noble women's hair were being undone,

verses.text:
निर्मर्यादे तथा युद्धे वर्तमाने सुदारुणे ।
प्रादुरासन्विनाशाय तदोत्पाताः सुदारुणाः ।
चचाल शब्दं कुर्वाणा सपर्वतवना मही ॥

meaning.en: and the savage, boundless battle was going on, dreadful omens appeared for destruction. The earth, with its mountains and forests, shook with a roar.

verses.text:
सदण्डाः सोल्मुका राजञ्शीर्यमाणाः समन्ततः ।
उल्काः पेतुर्दिवो भूमावाहत्य रविमण्डलम् ॥

meaning.en: Meteors, with their shafts and flaming tails, fell from the sky onto the earth, scattering all around after striking the disk of the sun, O king.

verses.text:
विष्वग्वाताः प्रादुरासन्नीचैः शर्करवर्षिणः ।
अश्रूणि मुमुचुर्नागा वेपथुश्चास्पृशद्भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: Winds blew from every side, low and raining gravel; elephants shed tears and a violent trembling seized them.

verses.text:
एतान्घोराननादृत्य समुत्पातान्सुदारुणान् ।
पुनर्युद्धाय संमन्त्र्य क्षत्रियास्तस्थुरव्यथाः ।
रमणीये कुरुक्षेत्रे पुण्ये स्वर्गं यियासवः ॥

meaning.en: Ignoring those dreadful and fearsome omens, the kshatriyas took counsel and stood unshaken, ready to fight again in holy, lovely Kurukshetra, longing to go to heaven.

verses.text:
ततो गान्धारराजस्य पुत्रः शकुनिरब्रवीत् ।
युध्यध्वमग्रतो यावत्पृष्ठतो हन्मि पाण्डवान् ॥

meaning.en: Then Shakuni, son of the king of Gandhara, said: "Keep fighting in front while I strike the Pandavas from behind."

verses.text:
ततो नः संप्रयातानां मद्रयोधास्तरस्विनः ।
हृष्टाः किलकिलाशब्दमकुर्वन्तापरे तथा ॥

meaning.en: As we advanced, the mighty Madra warriors on the other side joyfully raised shouts of triumph.

verses.text:
अस्मांस्तु पुनरासाद्य लब्धलक्षा दुरासदाः ।
शरासनानि धुन्वन्तः शरवर्षैरवाकिरन् ॥

meaning.en: Meeting us again, those hard-to-approach men, having found their marks, twanged their bows and showered us with arrows.

verses.text:
ततो हतं परैस्तत्र मद्रराजबलं तदा ।
दुर्योधनबलं दृष्ट्वा पुनरासीत्पराङ्मुखम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the Madra king's force was struck down by the enemy, and on seeing Duryodhana's force it turned away again.

verses.text:
गान्धारराजस्तु पुनर्वाक्यमाह ततो बली ।
निवर्तध्वमधर्मज्ञा युध्यध्वं किं सृतेन वः ॥

meaning.en: Then the mighty king of Gandhara spoke again: "Turn back, you who do not know dharma! What use is your running away? Fight!"

verses.text:
अनीकं दशसाहस्रमश्वानां भरतर्षभ ।
आसीद्गान्धारराजस्य विमलप्रासयोधिनाम् ॥

meaning.en: The king of Gandhara had a division of ten thousand horsemen, O bull of the Bharatas, spear-fighters with bright lances.

verses.text:
बलेन तेन विक्रम्य वर्तमाने जनक्षये ।
पृष्ठतः पाण्डवानीकमभ्यघ्नन्निशितैः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: Charging with that force while the slaughter of men went on, they struck the Pandava army from behind with sharp arrows.

verses.text:
तदभ्रमिव वातेन क्षिप्यमाणं समन्ततः ।
अभज्यत महाराज पाण्डूनां सुमहद्बलम् ॥

meaning.en: That huge Pandava force, O great king, was scattered everywhere and broke like a cloud driven by the wind.

verses.text:
ततो युधिष्ठिरः प्रेक्ष्य भग्नं स्वबलमन्तिकात् ।
अभ्यचोदयदव्यग्रः सहदेवं महाबलम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Yudhishthira, seeing his own force broken nearby, calmly urged on the mighty Sahadeva.

verses.text:
असौ सुबलपुत्रो नो जघनं पीड्य दंशितः ।
सेनां निसूदयन्त्येष पश्य पाण्डव दुर्मतिम् ॥

meaning.en: "That son of Subala, armored, is pressing on our rear and slaughtering the army. Look at that evil-minded man, son of Pandu!

verses.text:
गच्छ त्वं द्रौपदेयाश्च शकुनिं सौबलं जहि ।
रथानीकमहं रक्ष्ये पाञ्चालसहितोऽनघ ॥

meaning.en: Go, you and the sons of Draupadi, and kill Shakuni, Subala's son. Blameless one, I with the Panchalas will guard the chariot force.

verses.text:
गच्छन्तु कुञ्जराः सर्वे वाजिनश्च सह त्वया ।
पादाताश्च त्रिसाहस्राः शकुनिं सौबलं जहि ॥

meaning.en: Let all the elephants and horses go with you, and three thousand foot soldiers too. Kill Shakuni, Subala's son."

verses.text:
ततो गजाः सप्तशताश्चापपाणिभिरास्थिताः ।
पञ्च चाश्वसहस्राणि सहदेवश्च वीर्यवान् ॥

meaning.en: Then seven hundred elephants, bow-bearing men mounted on them, five thousand horses and the mighty Sahadeva,

verses.text:
पादाताश्च त्रिसाहस्रा द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः ।
रणे ह्यभ्यद्रवंस्ते तु शकुनिं युद्धदुर्मदम् ॥

meaning.en: three thousand foot soldiers and the sons of Draupadi, all together, charged in the battle at Shakuni, wild for the fight.

verses.text:
ततस्तु सौबलो राजन्नभ्यतिक्रम्य पाण्डवान् ।
जघान पृष्ठतः सेनां जयगृध्रः प्रतापवान् ॥

meaning.en: But Shakuni, Subala's son, O king, eager for victory and mighty, slipped past the Pandavas and struck their army from behind.

verses.text:
अश्वारोहास्तु संरब्धाः पाण्डवानां तरस्विनाम् ।
प्राविशन्सौबलानीकमभ्यतिक्रम्य तान्रथान् ॥

meaning.en: The furious horsemen of the mighty Pandavas passed those chariots and entered Shakuni's force.

verses.text:
ते तत्र सादिनः शूराः सौबलस्य महद्बलम् ।
गजमध्येऽवतिष्ठन्तः शरवर्षैरवाकिरन् ॥

meaning.en: Those brave horsemen, standing among the elephants, showered a great rain of arrows on Shakuni's large force.

verses.text:
तदुद्यतगदाप्रासमकापुरुषसेवितम् ।
प्रावर्तत महद्युद्धं राजन्दुर्मन्त्रिते तव ॥

meaning.en: Then a great battle began, with maces and spears raised, joined by no cowards, as a result of your own bad counsel, O king.

verses.text:
उपारमन्त ज्याशब्दाः प्रेक्षका रथिनोऽभवन् ।
न हि स्वेषां परेषां वा विशेषः प्रत्यदृश्यत ॥

meaning.en: The twang of bowstrings fell silent and the chariot-fighters became onlookers, for no difference could be seen between one's own side and the enemy's.

verses.text:
शूरबाहुविसृष्टानां शक्तीनां भरतर्षभ ।
ज्योतिषामिव संपातमपश्यन्कुरुपाण्डवाः ॥

meaning.en: The Kurus and Pandavas watched the spears hurled by the arms of heroes fall like a rain of shooting stars, O bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
ऋष्टिभिर्विमलाभिश्च तत्र तत्र विशां पते ।
संपतन्तीभिराकाशमावृतं बह्वशोभत ॥

meaning.en: With bright lances and spears falling here and there, O lord of the people, the sky, thick with them, looked very splendid.

verses.text:
प्रासानां पततां राजन्रूपमासीत्समन्ततः ।
शलभानामिवाकाशे तदा भरतसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: The fall of the spears, O king, looked like locusts in the sky all around, O best of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गा विप्रविद्धैर्नियन्तृभिः ।
हयाः परिपतन्ति स्म शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Horses with every limb smeared in blood, their drivers flung down, ran about by hundreds and thousands.

verses.text:
अन्योन्यपरिपिष्टाश्च समासाद्य परस्परम् ।
अविक्षताः स्म दृश्यन्ते वमन्तो रुधिरं मुखैः ॥

meaning.en: Crushed against one another and colliding, they were seen unwounded, yet vomiting blood from their mouths.

verses.text:
ततोऽभवत्तमो घोरं सैन्येन रजसा वृते ।
तानपाक्रमतोऽद्राक्षं तस्माद्देशादरिंदमान् ।
अश्वान्राजन्मनुष्यांश्च रजसा संवृते सति ॥

meaning.en: Then a dreadful darkness came, the army being wrapped in dust. In that dust I saw the foe-subduers moving away from that place, with horses and men.

verses.text:
भूमौ निपतिताश्चान्ये वमन्तो रुधिरं बहु ।
केशाकेशिसमालग्ना न शेकुश्चेष्टितुं जनाः ॥

meaning.en: Others fell on the ground vomiting much blood; locked together by the hair, the men could not move.

verses.text:
अन्योन्यमश्वपृष्ठेभ्यो विकर्षन्तो महाबलाः ।
मल्ला इव समासाद्य निजघ्नुरितरेतरम् ।
अश्वैश्च व्यपकृष्यन्त बहवोऽत्र गतासवः ॥

meaning.en: The mighty men, dragging each other from horseback, grappled like wrestlers and killed one another; and many, lifeless, were dragged along by horses.

verses.text:
भूमौ निपतिताश्चान्ये बहवो विजयैषिणः ।
तत्र तत्र व्यदृश्यन्त पुरुषाः शूरमानिनः ॥

meaning.en: Many others, eager for victory, lay fallen on the ground, and men who thought themselves heroes were seen here and there.

verses.text:
रक्तोक्षितैश्छिन्नभुजैरपकृष्टशिरोरुहैः ।
व्यदृश्यत मही कीर्णा शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: The earth was seen strewn by hundreds and thousands with men drenched in blood, their arms cut off and their hair torn away.

verses.text:
दूरं न शक्यं तत्रासीद्गन्तुमश्वेन केनचित् ।
साश्वारोहैर्हतैरश्वैरावृते वसुधातले ॥

meaning.en: No horse could go any distance there, the surface of the earth being covered with slain horses and their riders.

verses.text:
रुधिरोक्षितसंनाहैरात्तशस्त्रैरुदायुधैः ।
नानाप्रहरणैर्घोरैः परस्परवधैषिभिः ।
सुसंनिकृष्टैः संग्रामे हतभूयिष्ठसैनिकैः ॥

meaning.en: With armor soaked in blood, weapons seized and raised, with many dreadful weapons, each seeking the other's death, locked in close combat, most of the soldiers had been killed.

verses.text:
स मुहूर्तं ततो युद्ध्वा सौबलोऽथ विशां पते ।
षट्सहस्रैर्हयैः शिष्टैरपायाच्छकुनिस्ततः ॥

meaning.en: After fighting a moment, O lord of the people, Shakuni, Subala's son, withdrew with the six thousand horses that remained.

verses.text:
तथैव पाण्डवानीकं रुधिरेण समुक्षितम् ।
षट्सहस्रैर्हयैः शिष्टैरपायाच्छ्रान्तवाहनम् ॥

meaning.en: In the same way the Pandava force, drenched in blood and its mounts exhausted, withdrew with its six thousand remaining horses.

verses.text:
अश्वारोहास्तु पाण्डूनामब्रुवन्रुधिरोक्षिताः ।
सुसंनिकृष्टाः संग्रामे भूयिष्ठं त्यक्तजीविताः ॥

meaning.en: The Pandava horsemen, smeared with blood, locked in close combat in the battle and mostly ready to give up their lives, said:

verses.text:
नेह शक्यं रथैर्योद्धुं कुत एव महागजैः ।
रथानेव रथा यान्तु कुञ्जराः कुञ्जरानपि ॥

meaning.en: "One cannot fight here with chariots, let alone great elephants. Let chariots go against chariots and elephants against elephants.

verses.text:
प्रतियातो हि शकुनिः स्वमनीकमवस्थितः ।
न पुनः सौबलो राजा युद्धमभ्यागमिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Shakuni has gone back and stands with his own force; Subala's son the king will not come to fight again."

verses.text:
ततस्तु द्रौपदेयाश्च ते च मत्ता महाद्विपाः ।
प्रययुर्यत्र पाञ्चाल्यो धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः ॥

meaning.en: Then the sons of Draupadi and those rutting great elephants went to where the Panchala Dhrishtadyumna, the great chariot-fighter, stood.

verses.text:
सहदेवोऽपि कौरव्य रजोमेघे समुत्थिते ।
एकाकी प्रययौ तत्र यत्र राजा युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: Sahadeva too, O Kaurava, as the cloud of dust rose, went alone to where King Yudhishthira was.

verses.text:
ततस्तेषु प्रयातेषु शकुनिः सौबलः पुनः ।
पार्श्वतोऽभ्यहनत्क्रुद्धो धृष्टद्युम्नस्य वाहिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: When they had gone, Shakuni, Subala's son, furious, again struck Dhrishtadyumna's force on the flank.

verses.text:
तत्पुनस्तुमुलं युद्धं प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वाभ्यवर्तत ।
तावकानां परेषां च परस्परवधैषिणाम् ॥

meaning.en: Again a tumultuous battle raged, with both your men and the enemy giving up their lives, each seeking the other's death.

verses.text:
ते ह्यन्योन्यमवेक्षन्त तस्मिन्वीरसमागमे ।
योधाः पर्यपतन्राजञ्शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Looking at one another in that meeting of heroes, the warriors, O king, fell by hundreds and thousands.

verses.text:
असिभिश्छिद्यमानानां शिरसां लोकसंक्षये ।
प्रादुरासीन्महाशब्दस्तालानां पततामिव ॥

meaning.en: As swords cut off heads, in that destruction of the world a great sound arose, like palm fruits falling.

verses.text:
विमुक्तानां शरीराणां भिन्नानां पततां भुवि ।
सायुधानां च बाहूनामुरूणां च विशां पते ।
आसीत्कटकटाशब्दः सुमहान्रोमहर्षणः ॥

meaning.en: A great, hair-raising clatter arose, O lord of the people, from bodies dropped, split and falling to the ground, and from arms and thighs still holding weapons.

verses.text:
निघ्नन्तो निशितैः शस्त्रैर्भ्रातॄन्पुत्रान्सखीनपि ।
योधाः परिपतन्ति स्म यथामिषकृते खगाः ॥

meaning.en: Striking brothers, sons and friends with sharp weapons, the warriors fell upon one another like birds over meat.

verses.text:
अन्योन्यं प्रतिसंरब्धाः समासाद्य परस्परम् ।
अहं पूर्वमहं पूर्वमिति न्यघ्नन्सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Enraged at one another, meeting face to face, they slew by thousands, each crying "I first, I first!"

verses.text:
संघातैरासनभ्रष्टैरश्वारोहैर्गतासुभिः ।
हयाः परिपतन्ति स्म शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Dead horsemen, thrown from their seats in heaps, fell with their horses by hundreds and thousands.

verses.text:
स्फुरतां प्रतिपिष्टानामश्वानां शीघ्रसारिणाम् ।
स्तनतां च मनुष्याणां संनद्धानां विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: Of the swift horses that thrashed about, crushed, and of the groaning armored men, O lord of the people,

verses.text:
शक्त्यृष्टिप्रासशब्दश्च तुमुलः समजायत ।
भिन्दतां परमर्माणि राजन्दुर्मन्त्रिते तव ॥

meaning.en: a tumultuous noise of lances, spears and darts arose, as they pierced one another's vital spots, O king, through your evil counsel.

verses.text:
श्रमाभिभूताः संरब्धाः श्रान्तवाहाः पिपासिताः ।
विक्षताश्च शितैः शस्त्रैरभ्यवर्तन्त तावकाः ॥

meaning.en: Worn out with exhaustion, yet furious, with weary mounts, thirsty and wounded by sharp weapons, your men pressed on.

verses.text:
मत्ता रुधिरगन्धेन बहवोऽत्र विचेतसः ।
जघ्नुः परान्स्वकांश्चैव प्राप्तान्प्राप्ताननन्तरान् ॥

meaning.en: Many there, maddened by the smell of blood and out of their senses, struck down enemies and their own men alike, whoever came next.

verses.text:
बहवश्च गतप्राणाः क्षत्रिया जयगृद्धिनः ।
भूमावभ्यपतन्राजञ्शरवृष्टिभिरावृताः ॥

meaning.en: Many kshatriyas, greedy for victory, lost their lives and fell to the ground, O king, covered by showers of arrows.

verses.text:
वृकगृध्रशृगालानां तुमुले मोदनेऽहनि ।
आसीद्बलक्षयो घोरस्तव पुत्रस्य पश्यतः ॥

meaning.en: On that day of tumult, a feast for wolves, vultures and jackals, a dreadful destruction of forces happened before your son's eyes.

verses.text:
नराश्वकायसंछन्ना भूमिरासीद्विशां पते ।
रुधिरोदकचित्रा च भीरूणां भयवर्धिनी ॥

meaning.en: The ground, O lord of the people, was covered with the bodies of men and horses, streaked with rivers of blood, and it increased the fear of the timid.

verses.text:
असिभिः पट्टिशैः शूलैस्तक्षमाणाः पुनः पुनः ।
तावकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव नाभ्यवर्तन्त भारत ॥

meaning.en: Hacked again and again with swords, battle-axes and spears, your men and the Pandavas did not turn back, O Bharata.

verses.text:
प्रहरन्तो यथाशक्ति यावत्प्राणस्य धारणम् ।
योधाः परिपतन्ति स्म वमन्तो रुधिरं व्रणैः ॥

meaning.en: Striking as best they could so long as life remained, the warriors fell, vomiting blood from their wounds.

verses.text:
शिरो गृहीत्वा केशेषु कबन्धः समदृश्यत ।
उद्यम्य निशितं खड्गं रुधिरेण समुक्षितम् ॥

meaning.en: A headless trunk was seen holding a head by the hair, a sharp sword raised and soaked in blood.

verses.text:
अथोत्थितेषु बहुषु कबन्धेषु जनाधिप ।
तथा रुधिरगन्धेन योधाः कश्मलमाविशन् ॥

meaning.en: When many headless trunks had risen, O lord of men, the warriors, from the smell of blood, fell into a faint.

verses.text:
मन्दीभूते ततः शब्दे पाण्डवानां महद्बलम् ।
अल्पावशिष्टैस्तुरगैरभ्यवर्तत सौबलः ॥

meaning.en: When the noise had died down, Shakuni attacked the Pandava host with the few horses he had left.

verses.text:
ततोऽभ्यधावंस्त्वरिताः पाण्डवा जयगृद्धिनः ।
पदातयश्च नागाश्च सादिनश्चोद्यतायुधाः ॥

meaning.en: Then the Pandavas, eager for victory, hurried at him, foot soldiers, elephants and horsemen with raised weapons.

verses.text:
कोष्टकीकृत्य चाप्येनं परिक्षिप्य च सर्वशः ।
शस्त्रैर्नानाविधैर्जघ्नुर्युद्धपारं तितीर्षवः ॥

meaning.en: Hemming him in, surrounding him on all sides, they struck at him with weapons of many kinds, wishing to reach the far shore of the battle.

verses.text:
त्वदीयास्तांस्तु संप्रेक्ष्य सर्वतः समभिद्रुतान् ।
साश्वपत्तिद्विपरथाः पाण्डवानभिदुद्रुवुः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing them rushing on from all sides, your men, with horses, foot soldiers, elephants and chariots, ran at the Pandavas.

verses.text:
केचित्पदातयः पद्भिर्मुष्टिभिश्च परस्परम् ।
निजघ्नुः समरे शूराः क्षीणशस्त्रास्ततोऽपतन् ॥

meaning.en: Some brave foot soldiers in the battle struck each other with feet and fists, their weapons spent, and then fell.

verses.text:
रथेभ्यो रथिनः पेतुर्द्विपेभ्यो हस्तिसादिनः ।
विमानेभ्य इव भ्रष्टाः सिद्धाः पुण्यक्षयाद्यथा ॥

meaning.en: Chariot-fighters fell from chariots and elephant-riders from elephants, like Siddhas dropped from their celestial cars when their merit runs out.

verses.text:
एवमन्योन्यमायस्ता योधा जघ्नुर्महामृधे ।
पितॄन्भ्रातॄन्वयस्यांश्च पुत्रानपि तथापरे ॥

meaning.en: So in that great battle the warriors, stretching toward one another, killed fathers, brothers and friends, and others their sons too.

verses.text:
एवमासीदमर्यादं युद्धं भरतसत्तम ।
प्रासासिबाणकलिले वर्तमाने सुदारुणे ॥

meaning.en: So the battle became boundless, O best of the Bharatas, while the dreadful mingling of spears, swords and arrows went on.
